summary: Flat south kerb of a residential street, but homes within 17-25 m.
reasons: Flat in the low middle section

best_section.where: South kerb of Newcross Street, in the dip, opposite the parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Houses 17 m across the road and others 10-28 m on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Street is wide enough, with cars parked along the north side; some space on the south.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street between two cross roads.
drivers.convention: No signs; cars park along the street but residents would notice a van.

flags: Steep elsewhere: up to 14% at the west end
sun_shade: Trees shade the south side; open sun from the north.
cannot_judge: Whether the south kerb is usable by a van
